name: Lycabettus Loft
summary: A top-floor loft with a private terrace looking straight at Lycabettus Hill.
description: Exposed timber beams, a hand-plastered lime wall and floor-to-ceiling doors that open onto a 20 m² terrace. Mornings here start with coffee facing Lycabettus; evenings end with the city lights coming on below.

name: Strefi Suite
summary: Pine-green tones and a balcony that leans into the trees of Strefi Hill.
description: Named after the hill it faces, this suite brings the green indoors: olive linen, oak floors and a deep balcony shaded by the pines across the street. A day bed in the reading nook sleeps a third guest.
photoCaption: The steps up to Strefi Hill

name: Neapoli Studio
summary: A bright, compact studio for couples who plan to spend their days out exploring.
description: Clever built-in joinery, the original mosaic tiles and a tall window over Koumarianou Street. Everything you need in a calm, well-planned space, with a small writing desk for slower mornings.

name: Exarchia Family Apartment
summary: Two bedrooms, a proper kitchen and a long dining table for families and friends.
description: Our largest apartment, with two separate bedrooms, a full kitchen and a living room built around a 2.4 m oak dining table. A travel cot and high chair are available on request.

name: Courtyard Garden Apartment
summary: Opens onto the building's private courtyard with its old lemon tree and jasmine.
description: Step-free access, a stone-floored bathroom and French doors onto the shared courtyard, where the lemon tree planted by the building's first owners still bears fruit every winter.

name: Vecchia Classic
summary: The apartment that keeps the most of the original neoclassical house: high ceilings and restored shutters.
description: Restored wooden shutters, 3.6 m ceilings with original plaster mouldings and a vintage Greek armoire. A quiet, characterful room that feels like staying in an old Athenian home, because it is one.
